rationale: The Alert Notification Dependency Graph is an entirely new client-side surface (DependencyUsageCell + DependencyImpactDialog + useDependencyGraph composable). No existing spec exercises the 'Used by' column, the impact dialog, or the graph wiring — a repo-wide grep for dependency/used-by in the Alerts area returned zero matches. Existing specs (destinations-prebuilt, content-templates) cover CRUD/navigation for the same host pages but never the graph column. The feature doc specifies a dedicated spec file and this is its own feature area within Alerts, so a new spec (action:new) is correct rather than appending to a CRUD spec. CI runs only the files listed in ci_matrix.json's Alerts shard run_files, so the new file must be registered there (the playwright config itself uses testDir, but the CI matrix is the effective gate).
